title: Dashboard memory usage grows continuously while idle
body:
## Description
During a recorded session in OpsPanel, the user encountered: Dashboard memory usage grows continuously while idle.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Observe UI state: Dashboard
2. Observe UI state: Memory 2.8 GB
3. Observe UI state: Memory 4.5 GB

## Expected Behavior
The application should complete the user flow without errors.

## Actual Behavior
The session shows failure indicators including: Memory 4.5 GB.

## Environment
- App: OpsPanel
- Platform: desktop
